caption: The drawing features six separate square patterns arranged in two horizontal rows of three. The top left square depicts a white background with a random pattern of intersecting thin black and dotted lines, as well as small, circular black and light blue motifs at some intersections. The top middle square has a dark reddish-brown background with scattered small flowers in red, pink, and yellow, along with green leaves. The top right square shows a white background featuring a repeated design of yellow and black shapes with black dotted accents, resembling abstract butterflies. The bottom left square displays a grid pattern over a brown background, with the grid formed by small yellow squares at intersections, and overlaid with curling yellow vines and large pink flowers and green leaves. The bottom middle square consists of small evenly spaced black dots on a white background, with occasional straight blue lines forming right angles. The bottom right square has a reddish-brown background with diagonal white hatching and scalloped lines along the edge, decorated with repeating small motifs in white and red that appear to include a stylized hat shape.
title: Materials from Quilt
